 for(const m of raw.matchAll(direct)){const name=m[1],rel=m[0].lastIndexOf(name);add((m.index??0)+rel,name)}
 const role=/\b(?:Apostol(?:orum|órum)|Mart(?:yrum|ýrum)|Confessoris|Virginis|Episcopi|Abbatis|Pontificis|Doctoris)\s+(?:tu(?:orum|órum|i|ae|æ)\s+)?([A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ÞÆŒ][\p{L}’'’-]{2,})(?:\s+et\s+([A-ZÀ-ÖØ-ÞÆŒ][\p{L}’'’-]{2,}))?/gu;
 for(const m of raw.matchAll(role)){
  const a=m[1],ra=m[0].indexOf(a);add((m.index??0)+ra,a);
  if(m[2]){const rb=m[0].lastIndexOf(m[2]);add((m.index??0)+rb,m[2])}
 }
 return out;
}
function insertIdentityHits(scope,hits,l){
 let placed=0;
 const byNode=new Map();
 for(const h of hits){if(!h?.node||h.index<0||!h.length)continue;(byNode.get(h.node)||byNode.set(h.node,[]).get(h.node)).push(h)}

  rows.sort((a,b)=>b.index-a.index);

   const anchor=node.splitText(h.index),after=anchor.splitText(Math.min(h.length,anchor.nodeValue.length));
   anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(cue(h.ev,l,'aoCueRitual'),anchor);placed++;

 }
 return placed;
}
function placeIdentityNameBows(root,stepId,l){
 let placed=0;
 const scopes=holyNameScopes(root);
 const marian=[],pope=[],saints=[];
 for(const scope of scopes){for(const node of textNodes(scope)){
  const raw=node.nodeValue||'';
  for(const h of mariaTokenHits(raw))marian.push({node,...h,ev:{kind:'bow',label:'Bow at Our Lady’s name',status:'custom',authority:MARIAN_BOW_AUTHORITY,sourceKey:IDENTITY_BOW_SOURCE,sourceRefs:['OCONNELL_1962'],prominence:'DETAIL',nameBow:'mary'}});
  if(POPE_NAME_STEPS.has(stepId))for(const h of popeTokenHits(raw))pope.push({node,...h,ev:{kind:'bow',label:'Bow at the Pope’s name',status:'custom',authority:POPE_BOW_AUTHORITY,sourceKey:IDENTITY_BOW_SOURCE,sourceRefs:['MR_1962','OCONNELL_1962'],prominence:'DETAIL',nameBow:'pope'}});

 }}
 placed+=insertIdentityHits(root,[...marian,...pope,...saints],l);
 return placed;
}
function exactNeedles(stepId,ev,index,l){
 const a=[]; if(l==='fr'&&FR_ANCHOR[stepId]?.[index])a.push(FR_ANCHOR[stepId][index]);
 if(l==='en'&&ev.anchorEng)a.push(ev.anchorEng); if(ev.anchorLat)a.push(ev.anchorLat); if(ev.anchorEng)a.push(ev.anchorEng);
 return [...new Set(a.filter(Boolean))];
}
function locate(root,needles){
 const scopes=[...root.querySelectorAll('.massText')]; scopes.sort((a,b)=>(a.closest('.swapAlt')?1:0)-(b.closest('.swapAlt')?1:0));
 // Some response/dialogue rows are rendered outside .massText. Search the whole step last,
 // after the preferred text panels, so exact ritual cues remain inline rather than falling back to the top.
 scopes.push(root);
 const seen=new Set();
 for(const scope of scopes){ if(seen.has(scope))continue; seen.add(scope); for(const n of textNodes(scope)){ const raw=n.nodeValue||'', folded=norm(raw);
   for(const needle of needles){ const exact=String(needle); let at=raw.indexOf(exact); if(at<0)at=raw.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(exact.toLocaleLowerCase());
    if(at>=0)return {node:n,index:at,length:exact.length,scope};
    const nf=norm(exact); if(nf&&folded.includes(nf)){ const first=nf.split(' ')[0], approx=raw.toLocaleLowerCase().indexOf(first.toLocaleLowerCase()); if(approx>=0)return {node:n,index:approx,length:first.length,scope}; }
   }
 }} return null;

function place(root,stepId,ev,index,l){

 if(!hit){el.classList.add('aoCueFallback');root.prepend(el);return false;}
 const anchorStart=hit.node.splitText(hit.index), after=anchorStart.splitText(Math.min(hit.length,anchorStart.nodeValue.length));

function ritualCueFromAction(action){
 const label=String(action.label||''); let kind='action';
 if(/genuflect|génuflex/i.test(label))kind='genuflect'; else if(/kneel|genoux|agenou/i.test(label))kind='kneel'; else if(/rise|stand|debout|levez/i.test(label))kind='rise'; else if(/cross|croix/i.test(label))kind='cross';
 return {kind,label,status:'custom',source:action.source||'special_day_step'};
}
function timeline(stepId,l){
 if(form()!=='sung'||!['gloria','credo'].includes(stepId))return null;
 const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='aoPostureTimeline';const lab=document.createElement('div');lab.className='aoPostureTimelineLabel';lab.textContent=l==='fr'?'Séquence de posture · usage local/traditionnel':'Posture sequence · local/traditional custom';box.append(lab);
 const flow=document.createElement('div');flow.className='aoPostureTimelineFlow';const seq=[['stand','Stand','Debout'],['sit','Sit while the schola continues','Assis pendant que la schola continue'],['stand','Stand at the conclusion','Debout à la conclusion']];
 seq.forEach((x,i)=>{if(i){const a=document.createElement('span');a.className='aoPostureArrow';a.textContent='→';flow.append(a)}flow.append(cue({kind:x[0],label:l==='fr'?x[2]:x[1],status:'custom',authority:AUTHORITY.LOCAL_CUSTOM,sourceRefs:['SCR_1958']},l,'aoCueLocal'))});box.append(flow);
 const note=document.createElement('p');note.className='aoPostureTimelineNote';const incarnationSpecial=stepId==='credo'&&isSpecialIncarnationSung();note.textContent=l==='fr'?(stepId==='credo'?(incarnationSpecial?'À Noël et à l’Annonciation, à la Messe chantée, tous s’agenouillent pendant « Et incarnatus est »; le repère exact apparaît ci-dessous.':'La génuflexion à « Et incarnatus est » apparaît exactement dans le texte ci-dessous.'):'Les transitions assis/debout pendant une Messe chantée relèvent de l’usage local; le signe de croix final apparaît exactement dans le texte.'):(stepId==='credo'?(incarnationSpecial?'At Christmas and the Annunciation in a Sung Mass, all kneel during Et incarnatus est; the exact cue is marked below.':'The genuflection at Et incarnatus est is marked at the exact words below.'):'Sitting/standing during a Sung Mass follows local custom; the concluding sign of the cross is marked at the exact words below.');box.append(note);return box;
}
function enhance(screen){
 if(!screen||handled.has(screen))return; const stepId=screen.dataset.stepId||''; if(!stepId)return;
 let texts=screen.querySelector('.massTexts'); if(!texts){texts=document.createElement('section');texts.className='massTexts';const actions=screen.querySelector('.liveContextActions');actions?.parentNode?.insertBefore(texts,actions||null)}
 const orientation=screen.querySelector('.liveOrientation'); if(orientation){orientation.classList.add('aoInlineOrientation');texts.prepend(orientation)}
 const l=lang(),tl=timeline(stepId,l);if(tl){const orient=texts.querySelector('.aoInlineOrientation');orient?orient.after(tl):texts.prepend(tl)}
 screen.querySelectorAll('.liveCues .gesture').forEach(x=>x.remove()); const rec=REGISTRY[stepId]||{gestures:[],ritualActions:[]};
 const indexed=(rec.gestures||[]).map((ev,i)=>({ev:effectiveEvent(stepId,ev),i})).filter(({ev})=>eventApplies(stepId,ev)), ordered=[];

 handled.add(screen);screen.dataset.inlineCuesV251='1';

function scan(){document.querySelectorAll('.liveScreen').forEach(enhance)}

if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
window.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251={version:VERSION,participationEngineVersion:PARTICIPATION_ENGINE_VERSION,guideVersion:GUIDE_VERSION,registrySteps:Object.keys(REGISTRY).length,authorityClasses:AUTHORITY,sourceRegistry:SOURCE_REGISTRY,sourcePolicy:{bows:'traditional/custom for faithful; not asserted as universal 1962 lay rubric',holyName:'audible/sung public-text rule only',identityNames:'Marian identity phrases; Pope N. placeholder; active saint invocation formulas in Collect/Secret/Postcommunion only',sourceKey:'oconnell1962_bows_traditional_custom',identitySourceKey:IDENTITY_BOW_SOURCE},guideForEvent,openGuide:openCueGuide,closeGuide:closeCueGuide,detectCompatibilityVariant,scan,getRegistry(){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(REGISTRY))},context(){return {properPath:activeProperPath(),requiem:isRequiemMass(),specialIncarnationSung:isSpecialIncarnationSung(),marianCelebration:isMarianCelebration(),activeSaintContext:hasActiveSaintContext(),form:form(),language:lang()}},diagnostic(){const screen=document.querySelector('.liveScreen');if(!screen)return {version:VERSION,live:false,context:this.context()};return {version:VERSION,live:true,stepId:screen.dataset.stepId||null,orientationInsideText:!!screen.querySelector('.massTexts>.aoInlineOrientation'),detachedGestureCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.liveCues .gesture').length,inlineCueCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.massTexts .aoInlineCue').length,guideableCueCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.massTexts .aoInlineCue[data-ao-guideable="1"]').length,holyNameBowCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.aoInlineCue[data-ao-cue-authority="'+HOLY_NAME_AUTHORITY+'"]').length,doxologyBowCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.aoInlineCue[data-ao-cue-authority="'+DOXOLOGY_BOW_AUTHORITY+'"]').length,marianNameBowCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.aoInlineCue[data-ao-cue-name-bow="mary"]').length,saintNameBowCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.aoInlineCue[data-ao-cue-name-bow="saint"]').length,popeNameBowCount:screen.querySelectorAll('.aoInlineCue[data-ao-cue-name-bow="pope"]').length,multiPosture:!!screen.querySelector('.aoPostureTimeline:not(.aoRitualActionRail)'),context:this.context()}}};
window.AO_INLINE_CUES_V252=window.AO_INLINE_CUES_V251;

<script id="ao-daily-catechism-v357-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const VERSION='35.7-daily-catechism';
const KEY='ao_daily_catechism_v1';
const TOTAL=10;
const REVIEW_INTERVALS=[0,2,7,14,30,60];
let openState={open:false,revealed:false,loading:false,error:'',language:null};
let homeQueued=false,midnightTimer=null,storeHooked=false;
const api=()=>window.AO_TRADITIONAL_CATECHISM||null;
const rt=()=>window.AO_RUNTIME_V8||null;
const appState=()=>rt()?.store?.getState?.()||null;
const lang=()=>appState()?.language==='fr'?'fr':'en';
const L=(en,fr)=>lang()==='fr'?fr:en;
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
function load(){try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}');if(x&&x.version===1)return x}catch{}return {version:1,sessions:{},history:{},completionDates:[]}}
function save(s){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(s))}catch{}return s}
function dateKey(d=new Date()){const y=d.getFullYear(),m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');return `${y}-${m}-${day}`}
function addDays(key,n){const d=new Date(`${key}T12:00:00`);d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);return dateKey(d)}
function hash(s){let h=2166136261;for(const c of String(s)){h^=c.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0}
function rng(seed){let a=hash(seed)||1;return()=>{a+=0x6D2B79F5;let t=a;t=Math.imul(t^t>>>15,t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,t|61);return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
function shuffle(a,r){a=[...a];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(r()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function currentTitle(){const s=appState();if(s?.selectedDate&&s.selectedDate!==dateKey())return '';return String(s?.resolution?.day?.main?.title||s?.resolution?.main?.title||'')}
function contextTerms(title=currentTitle()){
 const x=title.toLowerCase();
 const sets=[
  [['corpus christi','eucharist','sacred heart','holy thursday','first friday','saint-sacrement','eucharistie','sacré-cœur','jeudi saint'],['eucharist','holy communion','mass','body of christ','blood of christ','communion','messe']],
  [['immaculate','assumption','mary','rosary','notre-dame','marie','immaculée','assomption','rosaire'],['mary','blessed virgin','mother of god','virgin mary','marie','sainte vierge','mère de dieu']],
  [['pentecost','holy spirit','holy ghost','pentecôte','saint-esprit'],['holy spirit','holy ghost','saint-esprit']],
  [['trinity','trinité'],['trinity','trinité']],
  [['christmas','nativity','noël','nativité','advent','avent'],['incarnation','son of god','jesus christ','incarnation','fils de dieu','jésus-christ']],
  [['easter','resurrection','pâques','résurrection'],['resurrection','risen','résurrection','ressuscité']],
  [['passion','good friday','cross','vendredi saint','croix'],['passion','cross','redemption','croix','rédemption']],
  [['all saints','saints','toussaint'],['communion of saints','saints','communion des saints']],
  [['all souls','requiem','dead','défunts','trépassés'],['purgatory','dead','purgatoire','défunts']],
  [['lent','quadragesima','carême'],['penance','fast','prayer','pénitence','jeûne','prière']]
 ];
 for(const [keys,terms] of sets)if(keys.some(k=>x.includes(k)))return terms;
 return []
}
function partLabel(p){return ({intro:L('Foundations','Fondements'),faith:L('Creed & Faith','Credo & Foi'),moral:L('Commandments','Commandements'),grace:L('Sacraments','Sacrements'),prayer:L('Prayer','Prière')})[p]||L('Catechism','Catéchisme')}
function stats(s=load()){const day=dateKey(),month=day.slice(0,7);const h=Object.values(s.history||{});return {encountered:h.filter(x=>x&&x.seen).length,due:h.filter(x=>x&&x.due&&x.due<=day).length,month:(s.completionDates||[]).filter(x=>x.startsWith(month)).length,learned:api()?.learnedCount?.()||0}}
function isWeak(h){return !!h&&h.lastOutcome==='review'}
function isDue(h,day){return !!h&&h.lastOutcome==='knew'&&(!h.due||h.due<=day)}
function pickDiverse(pool,count,used,r,parts=['intro','faith','moral','grace','prayer']){
 const groups=new Map(parts.map(p=>[p,[]]));const other=[];
 for(const q of shuffle(pool.filter(q=>!used.has(q.n)),r)){(groups.get(q.part)||other).push(q)}
 const out=[];let idx=Math.floor(r()*parts.length),guard=0;
 while(out.length<count&&guard<100){guard++;let moved=false;for(let k=0;k<parts.length&&out.length<count;k++){const p=parts[(idx+k)%parts.length],g=groups.get(p);while(g?.length&&used.has(g[0].n))g.shift();if(g?.length){const q=g.shift();used.add(q.n);out.push(q);moved=true}}idx=(idx+1)%parts.length;if(!moved)break}
 const rest=shuffle([...groups.values()].flat().concat(other).filter(q=>!used.has(q.n)),r);for(const q of rest){if(out.length>=count)break;used.add(q.n);out.push(q)}return out
}
function contextualQuestion(qs,s,used,r){const terms=contextTerms();if(!terms.length)return null;const candidates=qs.filter(q=>!used.has(q.n)&&terms.some(k=>(`${q.q} ${q.a}`).toLowerCase().includes(k)));if(!candidates.length)return null;const unseen=candidates.filter(q=>!s.history?.[q.n]&&!api()?.isLearned?.(q.n));const due=candidates.filter(q=>isWeak(s.history?.[q.n])||isDue(s.history?.[q.n],dateKey()));const pool=unseen.length?unseen:due.length?due:candidates;return shuffle(pool,r)[0]||null}
function buildSession(qs,s){const day=dateKey(),r=rng(`${day}|daily-catechism`),used=new Set,ids=[];let contextualId=null;
 const cq=contextualQuestion(qs,s,used,r);if(cq){used.add(cq.n);ids.push(cq.n);contextualId=cq.n}
 const weak=qs.filter(q=>isWeak(s.history?.[q.n]));
 const review=qs.filter(q=>!isWeak(s.history?.[q.n])&&(isDue(s.history?.[q.n],day)||(!s.history?.[q.n]&&api()?.isLearned?.(q.n))));
 const fresh=qs.filter(q=>!s.history?.[q.n]&&!api()?.isLearned?.(q.n));
 const quotas=cq?[[fresh,4],[review,3],[weak,2]]:[[fresh,5],[review,3],[weak,2]];
 for(const [pool,count] of quotas)ids.push(...pickDiverse(pool,count,used,r).map(q=>q.n));
 if(ids.length<TOTAL){const fallback=qs.filter(q=>!used.has(q.n));ids.push(...pickDiverse(fallback,TOTAL-ids.length,used,r).map(q=>q.n))}
 const session={date:day,ids:ids.slice(0,TOTAL),index:0,outcomes:{},completedAt:null,contextualId,createdAt:Date.now()};s.sessions[day]=session;save(s);return session}
async function ensureSession(){const a=api();if(!a)throw new Error('Catechism is not ready.');const lg=lang();let qs=a.questions?.(lg)||[];if(qs.length<433){try{await a.load?.(lg)}catch{}qs=a.questions?.(lg)||qs}if(qs.length<TOTAL)throw new Error(lg==='fr'?'Le Catéchisme quotidien nécessite une première connexion pour charger le texte français.':'Daily Catechism needs at least ten available questions.');const s=load(),day=dateKey();let session=s.sessions?.[day];if(!session||!Array.isArray(session.ids)||session.ids.length!==TOTAL)session=buildSession(qs,s);return {s,session,qs}}
function nextIndex(session){for(let i=0;i<session.ids.length;i++)if(!session.outcomes?.[session.ids[i]])return i;return session.ids.length}
function recordOutcome(id,outcome){const s=load(),session=s.sessions?.[dateKey()];if(!session)return;session.outcomes=session.outcomes||{};session.outcomes[id]=outcome;const old=s.history[id]||{seen:0,knew:0,review:0,level:0};const h={...old};h.seen=(h.seen||0)+1;h.last=dateKey();h.lastOutcome=outcome;if(outcome==='knew'){h.knew=(h.knew||0)+1;h.level=Math.min(5,(h.level||0)+1);h.due=addDays(h.last,REVIEW_INTERVALS[h.level]||60);api()?.setLearned?.(id,true)}else{h.review=(h.review||0)+1;h.level=0;h.due=addDays(h.last,1);api()?.setLearned?.(id,false)}s.history[id]=h;session.index=nextIndex(session);if(session.index>=TOTAL){session.completedAt=Date.now();if(!(s.completionDates||[]).includes(session.date)){s.completionDates=s.completionDates||[];s.completionDates.push(session.date)}}save(s);openState.revealed=false;render();queueHome()}
function close(){document.getElementById('ao-daily-cate-root')?.remove();document.body.classList.remove('aoDailyCateOpen');openState={open:false,revealed:false,loading:false,error:'',language:null};queueHome()}
function shell(){let root=document.getElementById('ao-daily-cate-root');if(root)return root;root=document.createElement('div');root.id='ao-daily-cate-root';root.className='aoDailyCateBackdrop';root.innerHTML='<section class="aoDailyCateSheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"></section>';document.body.appendChild(root);document.body.classList.add('aoDailyCateOpen');root.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===root)close()});return root.querySelector('.aoDailyCateSheet')}
function top(){return `<header class="aoDailyCateTop"><button type="button" data-dc-close aria-label="${esc(L('Close','Fermer'))}">×</button><div><small>${esc(L('DAILY FORMATION','FORMATION QUOTIDIENNE'))}</small><strong>${esc(L('Daily Catechism','Catéchisme quotidien'))}</strong></div><span></span></header>`}
async function open(){openState.open=true;openState.loading=true;openState.error='';openState.revealed=false;openState.language=lang();shell();render();try{await ensureSession()}catch(e){openState.error=String(e?.message||e)}finally{openState.loading=false;render();queueHome()}}
function render(){if(!openState.open)return;const box=shell();if(openState.loading){box.innerHTML=`${top()}<div class="aoDailyCateBody"><div class="aoDailyCateEmpty"><h2>${esc(L('Preparing today’s lesson…','Préparation de la leçon du jour…'))}</h2><p>${esc(L('Loading your Catechism questions and review schedule.','Chargement des questions et du programme de révision.'))}</p></div></div>`;return}if(openState.error){box.innerHTML=`${top()}<div class="aoDailyCateBody"><div class="aoDailyCateEmpty"><h2>${esc(L('Daily lesson unavailable','Leçon quotidienne indisponible'))}</h2><p>${esc(openState.error)}</p><button class="aoDailyCatePrimary" data-dc-full>${esc(L('Open full Catechism','Ouvrir le Catéchisme complet'))}</button></div></div>`;return}
 const s=load(),session=s.sessions?.[dateKey()],qs=api()?.questions?.(lang())||[];if(!session){openState.error=L('Could not create today’s lesson.','Impossible de créer la leçon du jour.');return render()}
 const done=Object.keys(session.outcomes||{}).length,st=stats(s);if(session.completedAt||done>=TOTAL){box.innerHTML=`${top()}<div class="aoDailyCateBody"><div class="aoDailyCateSummary"><div class="mark">✓</div><h2>${esc(L('Daily lesson complete','Leçon quotidienne terminée'))}</h2><p>${esc(L('Ten questions completed today. Come back tomorrow for a new set.','Dix questions terminées aujourd’hui. Revenez demain pour une nouvelle série.'))}</p></div><div class="aoDailyCateStats"><div class="aoDailyCateStat"><b>${st.encountered}/433</b><span>${esc(L('questions encountered','questions rencontrées'))}</span></div><div class="aoDailyCateStat"><b>${st.due}</b><span>${esc(L('due for review','à revoir'))}</span></div><div class="aoDailyCateStat"><b>${st.month}</b><span>${esc(L('daily lessons this month','leçons ce mois-ci'))}</span></div></div><button class="aoDailyCatePrimary" data-dc-full>${esc(L('Open full Catechism','Ouvrir le Catéchisme complet'))}</button></div>`;return}
 const idx=nextIndex(session);session.index=idx;save(s);const id=session.ids[idx],q=qs.find(x=>x.n===id)||api()?.question?.(id,lang());if(!q){openState.error=L('This question is unavailable in the current language.','Cette question n’est pas disponible dans la langue actuelle.');return render()}
 const pct=Math.round(done/TOTAL*100),context=session.contextualId===id;box.innerHTML=`${top()}<div class="aoDailyCateBody"><div class="aoDailyCateProgressHead"><b>${esc(L('Today’s lesson','Leçon du jour'))}</b><span>${done}/${TOTAL}</span></div><div class="aoDailyCateProgress"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div><article class="aoDailyCateCard ${context?'context':''}"><div class="aoDailyCateKicker"><span>${context?esc(L('TODAY’S THEME','THÈME DU JOUR')):esc(partLabel(q.part))}</span><span>Q ${q.n} / 433</span></div><h2>${esc(q.q)}</h2>${openState.revealed?`<div class="aoDailyCateAnswer">${esc(q.a)}</div><div class="aoDailyCateSource">${esc(L('Catechism of St Pius X','Catéchisme de Saint Pie X'))} · Q ${q.n}</div><div class="aoDailyCateActions"><button class="knew" data-dc-outcome="knew" data-id="${q.n}">${esc(L('I knew this','Je le savais'))}</button><button class="review" data-dc-outcome="review" data-id="${q.n}">${esc(L('Review again','À revoir'))}</button></div>`:`<button class="aoDailyCateReveal" data-dc-reveal>${esc(L('Reveal answer','Afficher la réponse'))}</button>`}<button class="aoDailyCateLink" data-dc-study="${q.n}">${esc(L('Study this question in the full Catechism','Étudier cette question dans le Catéchisme complet'))} →</button></article></div>`}
function homeCopy(){const s=load(),session=s.sessions?.[dateKey()],st=stats(s),done=session?Object.keys(session.outcomes||{}).length:0,complete=!!session?.completedAt||done>=TOTAL;if(complete)return {title:L('Daily Catechism','Catéchisme quotidien'),desc:L('Today’s ten questions are complete.','Les dix questions du jour sont terminées.'),badge:L('10/10 completed today','10/10 terminées aujourd’hui'),meta:`${st.encountered}/433 ${L('encountered','rencontrées')} · ${st.month} ${L('this month','ce mois-ci')}`,complete:true};if(session)return {title:L('Daily Catechism','Catéchisme quotidien'),desc:L('Continue today’s St Pius X lesson.','Continuez la leçon de Saint Pie X du jour.'),badge:`${done}/10 ${L('completed','terminées')}`,meta:`${st.due} ${L('due for review','à revoir')}`,complete:false};return {title:L('Daily Catechism','Catéchisme quotidien'),desc:L('Ten St Pius X questions: new material, review and weak points.','Dix questions de Saint Pie X : nouveautés, révision et points faibles.'),badge:L('10 questions · today','10 questions · aujourd’hui'),meta:st.encountered?`${st.encountered}/433 ${L('encountered','rencontrées')}`:L('Start your first daily lesson','Commencez votre première leçon'),complete:false}}
function ensureHome(){const home=document.querySelector('.homeScreen');if(!home)return;let card=home.querySelector('.aoDailyCateHome');const copy=homeCopy();if(!card){card=document.createElement('section');card.className='contentCard aoCateHomeCard aoDailyCateHome';const anchor=home.querySelector('.aoLearnHomeCard')||home.querySelector('.contentCard.gospelCard')||home.querySelector('.contentCard.massCard');if(!anchor)return;anchor.after(card)}card.classList.toggle('complete',copy.complete);const html=`<div class="cateCardCopy"><div class="cardKicker">${esc(L('Formation','Formation'))}</div><b>${esc(copy.title)}</b><p>${esc(copy.desc)}</p><span class="aoCateBadge">${esc(copy.badge)}</span><div class="aoDailyCateMeta"><span>${esc(copy.meta)}</span></div></div><button class="roundAction" type="button" data-dc-open aria-label="${esc(L('Open Daily Catechism','Ouvrir le Catéchisme quotidien'))}">→</button>`;if(card.dataset.signature!==html){card.innerHTML=html;card.dataset.signature=html}}
function queueHome(){if(homeQueued)return;homeQueued=true;queueMicrotask(()=>{homeQueued=false;ensureHome()})}
function scheduleMidnight(){clearTimeout(midnightTimer);const now=new Date(),next=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate()+1,0,0,2);midnightTimer=setTimeout(()=>{queueHome();scheduleMidnight()},Math.max(1000,next-now))}
function install(){if(storeHooked)return;const r=rt();if(!r?.store){setTimeout(install,80);return}storeHooked=true;r.store.subscribe(()=>{queueHome();if(openState.open&&openState.language!==lang()){openState.language=lang();openState.revealed=false;render()}});queueHome();setTimeout(queueHome,100);setTimeout(queueHome,700);scheduleMidnight()}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest?.('button,[data-dc-open]');if(!b)return;if(b.matches('[data-dc-open]')||b.closest('.aoDailyCateHome')&&b.classList.contains('roundAction')){e.preventDefault();open();return}if(b.matches('[data-dc-close]')){close();return}if(b.matches('[data-dc-reveal]')){openState.revealed=true;render();return}if(b.dataset.dcOutcome){recordOutcome(Number(b.dataset.id),b.dataset.dcOutcome);return}if(b.dataset.dcStudy){const id=Number(b.dataset.dcStudy),lg=lang();close();api()?.open?.({lang:lg,question:id});return}if(b.matches('[data-dc-full]')){const lg=lang();close();api()?.open?.({lang:lg});return}},true)
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&openState.open)close()})
install();
window.AO_DAILY_CATECHISM={version:VERSION,open,close,ensureHome,getState:()=>load(),resetToday(){const s=load();delete s.sessions[dateKey()];save(s);queueHome();return true},qa(){const s=load(),session=s.sessions?.[dateKey()];return {version:VERSION,date:dateKey(),sessionSize:session?.ids?.length||0,completed:!!session?.completedAt,encountered:stats(s).encountered,due:stats(s).due,month:stats(s).month,noDuplicateSessionIds:session?new Set(session.ids).size===session.ids.length:true,usesCanonicalCatechism:!!api()?.questions}}};
})();
</script>

(()=>{
  function compactLegacySourceBoxes(){
    document.querySelectorAll('#aoPrayerBookRoot .pbSource').forEach(el=>{
      if(el.dataset.ao357Compact==='1') return;
      const strong=el.querySelector('strong');
      const label=(strong?.textContent||'Note').trim()||'Note';
      if(strong) strong.remove();
      while(el.firstChild && el.firstChild.nodeName==='BR') el.firstChild.remove();
      const d=document.createElement('details');
      d.className='aoSourceDisclosure pbSourceCompact ao357LegacySource';
      const sm=document.createElement('summary'); sm.textContent=label;
      const body=document.createElement('div'); body.className='aoSourceDetail';
      while(el.firstChild) body.appendChild(el.firstChild);
      d.append(sm,body); el.dataset.ao357Compact='1'; el.replaceWith(d);
    });
  }
  window.AO_SOURCE_DISCLOSURE_V357={compact:compactLegacySourceBoxes};
  compactLegacySourceBoxes();
})();
</script>

  'offer-this-mass':'mass.intentions','mass-intentions':'mass.intentions',
  'MASS_OFFER_BALT_1888':{id:'mass.intentions',defaults:{method:COLLECTION.baltimore}},
  'prepare-communion':'mass.communion_prepare','communion-preparation':'mass.communion_prepare',

  'four-ends':'mass.four_ends','mass-four-ends':'mass.four_ends',

  'leonine':'mass.leonine','leonine-prayers':'mass.leonine','mass_devotion_leonine':'mass.leonine',

  'confession':'pray.confession',

  'stations':'pray.stations','stations-of-the-cross':'pray.stations',
  'benediction':'pray.benediction',

  'learn':'learn.mass','understand-mass':'learn.mass',
  'catechism':'learn.catechism','traditional-catechism':'learn.catechism',
  'daily-catechism':'learn.catechism.daily','today.daily-catechism':'learn.catechism.daily',

  'sources':'utility.sources','settings':'utility.settings'

const cssEscape=value=>globalThis.CSS?.escape?CSS.escape(String(value)):String(value).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,c=>`\\${c}`);

function nav(dest){return !!globalThis.AO_NAV_V25?.open?.(dest)}

function eucharistic(id,returnContext=null){if(returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(returnContext);return !!globalThis.AO_EUCHARISTIC_V354?.open?.(id)}
function scriptureGospel(returnContext=null){const root=document.getElementById('app');if(!root)return false;if(returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(returnContext);const route=store()?.getState?.()?.route||'home';root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ao:open-scripture',{bubbles:true,detail:{kind:'gospel',returnRoute:route==='scripture'?'home':route}}));globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.markCoreRoute?.('scripture');return true}
function navWithReturn(dest,returnContext=null){if(returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(returnContext);return nav(dest)}

function normalizeAliasEntry(entry){return typeof entry==='string'?{id:entry,defaults:{}}:{id:entry?.id||'',defaults:{...(entry?.defaults||{})}}}
function resolve(input){let id=String(input||'').trim(),defaults={},chain=[],seen=new Set();if(!id)return {ok:false,input,id:'',defaults,chain,error:'EMPTY_ID'};for(let depth=0;depth<16;depth++){
  if(DEFINITIONS[id])return {ok:true,input:String(input),id,defaults,chain,definition:DEFINITIONS[id]};

  seen.add(id);chain.push(id);const a=normalizeAliasEntry(raw);defaults={...a.defaults,...defaults};id=a.id;
 }
 return {ok:false,input:String(input),id,defaults,chain,error:'ALIAS_DEPTH'}
}

async function run(def,options={}){
 const a=def.action,arg=def.actionArg;
 switch(a){
  case 'nav.calendar': return navWithReturn('calendar',options.returnContext);
  case 'nav.saint': return navWithReturn('saint',options.returnContext);
  case 'nav.sources': return navWithReturn('sources',options.returnContext);
  case 'nav.settings': return navWithReturn('settings',options.returnContext);
  case 'nav.today-mass': return navWithReturn('today-mass',options.returnContext)||!!globalThis.AO_CELEBRATION_API?.openPreflight?.();
  case 'scripture.gospel': return scriptureGospel(options.returnContext);
  case 'mass.follow-safe':
    if(options.returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(options.returnContext);
    return !!globalThis.AO_CELEBRATION_API?.openPreflight?.();
  case 'store.enter-live':
    /* Compatibility-only internal action. UI entry is fail-closed through mass.follow-safe. */
    return false;
  case 'celebration.change':
    if(options.returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(options.returnContext);
    return !!globalThis.AO_CELEBRATION_API?.openChangeMass?.();
  case 'mass.prepare':
    if(options.method===COLLECTION.baltimore)return traditional('MASS_PREP_BALT_1888',options.returnContext);
    if(options.returnContext)return !!globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.openCore?.('prepare',options.returnContext);
    return dispatch({type:'enter-prepare'});
  case 'trad.intentions': return traditional('MASS_OFFER_BALT_1888',options.returnContext);
  case 'mass.communion-prepare':
    if(options.method===COLLECTION.lasance)return traditional('COMM_PREP_LAS_1911',options.returnContext);
    if(options.returnContext){if(!globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.openCore?.('prepare',options.returnContext))return false;dispatch({type:'prepare-communion',value:true});return true}
    if(!dispatch({type:'enter-prepare'}))return false;dispatch({type:'prepare-communion',value:true});return true;
  case 'trad.four-ends': return traditional('MASS_FOUR_ENDS_LAS_1911',options.returnContext);
  case 'mass.thanksgiving':
    if(options.method===COLLECTION.lasance)return traditional('COMM_THANKS_LAS_1911',options.returnContext);
    if(options.returnContext)return !!globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.openCore?.('thanksgiving',options.returnContext);
    return dispatch({type:'enter-thanksgiving'});
  case 'prayer.record': return prayerRecord(arg,options.returnContext);
  case 'prayerbook.open': {const fn=globalThis.AOTraditionalPrayerBook?.open;if(!fn)return false;const r=fn(options.returnContext?{returnContext:options.returnContext}:{});return r===false?false:true;}
  case 'prayerbook.module': return prayerBookModule(arg,options.returnContext);
  case 'pray.confession':
    if(options.method===COLLECTION.lasance)return traditional('CONFESSION_LAS_1911',options.returnContext);
    return prayerBookModule('confession',options.returnContext);
  case 'eucharistic.open': return eucharistic(arg,options.returnContext);
  case 'learn.mass': return openLearn(globalThis.AO_UNDERSTAND_MASS,{},options.returnContext);
  case 'learn.catechism': return openLearn(globalThis.AO_TRADITIONAL_CATECHISM,options,options.returnContext);
  case 'learn.daily-catechism':
    if(options.returnContext)globalThis.AO_NAV_V362?.setExternalReturn?.(options.returnContext);
    return !!globalThis.AO_DAILY_CATECHISM?.open?.();
  default:return false;
 }
}

async function open(input,options={}){
 const r=resolve(input);if(!r.ok)return {ok:false,input:String(input||''),canonicalId:null,error:r.error,aliasChain:r.chain};
 const def=r.definition;if(def.navigation===false||def.type==='collection')return {ok:false,input:String(input),canonicalId:r.id,error:'NON_NAVIGABLE_COLLECTION',aliasChain:r.chain};
 const merged={...r.defaults,...options};
 try{const opened=await run(def,merged);return {ok:!!opened,input:String(input),canonicalId:r.id,type:def.type,domain:def.domain,options:merged,aliasChain:r.chain,error:opened?null:'HANDLER_UNAVAILABLE'}}catch(error){return {ok:false,input:String(input),canonicalId:r.id,type:def.type,domain:def.domain,options:merged,aliasChain:r.chain,error:String(error?.message||error)}}
}

function aliasCycles(){const cycles=[];for(const start of Object.keys(ALIASES)){let id=start,seen=[];for(let i=0;i<20;i++){if(DEFINITIONS[id])break;const raw=ALIASES[id];if(!raw)break;const next=normalizeAliasEntry(raw).id;const pos=seen.indexOf(id);if(pos>=0){cycles.push([...seen.slice(pos),id]);break}seen.push(id);id=next}}return cycles}
function duplicateRenderers(){const map=new Map();for(const d of Object.values(DEFINITIONS)){if(!d.action||d.type==='collection')continue;const key=`${d.action}:${d.actionArg||''}`;if(!map.has(key))map.set(key,[]);map.get(key).push(d.id)}return [...map.entries()].filter(([,ids])=>ids.length>1).map(([renderer,ids])=>({renderer,ids}))}
function brokenReferences(){const out=[];for(const d of Object.values(DEFINITIONS)){for(const key of ['uses','providesFor'])for(const ref of d[key]||[])if(!DEFINITIONS[ref])out.push({from:d.id,field:key,to:ref});for(const m of d.methods||[])if(m!=='standard'&&!DEFINITIONS[m])out.push({from:d.id,field:'methods',to:m});if(d.sourceCollection&&!DEFINITIONS[d.sourceCollection])out.push({from:d.id,field:'sourceCollection',to:d.sourceCollection})}return out}
function unresolvedAliases(){const out=[];for(const id of Object.keys(ALIASES)){const r=resolve(id);if(!r.ok)out.push({alias:id,error:r.error,chain:r.chain})}return out}
function canonicalForElement(el){if(!el)return null;const d=el.dataset||{};
 if(d.action){const map={prepare:'mass.prepare',follow:'mass.follow',thanks:'mass.thanksgiving','today-mass':'mass.current',gospel:'today.gospel'};if(map[d.action])return map[d.action]}


 if(d.v261Adapter){const r=resolve(d.v261Adapter);if(r.ok)return r.id}
 if(d.ao354Open){const map={adoration:'pray.adoration','first-friday':'programme.first_friday','first-saturday':'programme.first_saturday',meditation:'programme.first_saturday_meditation'};if(map[d.ao354Open])return map[d.ao354Open]}
 if(d.ao354Launch){const map={adoration:'pray.adoration','first-friday':'programme.first_friday','first-saturday':'programme.first_saturday'};if(map[d.ao354Launch])return map[d.ao354Launch]}
 if(d.v25Destination){const map={prayers:'pray.library',calendar:'today.calendar',saint:'today.saint',settings:'utility.settings',sources:'utility.sources','today-mass':'mass.current'};if(map[d.v25Destination])return map[d.v25Destination]}
 if(d.dcOpen!==undefined)return 'learn.catechism.daily';
 return null
}
function auditDOM(root=document){const selector='[data-action],[data-v261-adapter],[data-ao354-open],[data-ao354-launch],[data-v25-destination],[data-dc-open]';const nodes=[...root.querySelectorAll(selector)],mapped=[],unmapped=[];for(const el of nodes){const id=canonicalForElement(el),row={tag:el.tagName?.toLowerCase()||'',text:(el.textContent||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,90),canonicalId:id};(id?mapped:unmapped).push(row)}return {launcherCount:nodes.length,mappedCount:mapped.length,unmappedCount:unmapped.length,mapped,unmapped}}
function qa(){const defs=Object.values(DEFINITIONS),byType=defs.reduce((m,d)=>(m[d.type]=(m[d.type]||0)+1,m),{}),domains=defs.reduce((m,d)=>{if(d.domain)m[d.domain]=(m[d.domain]||0)+1;return m},{}),cycles=aliasCycles(),broken=brokenReferences(),badAliases=unresolvedAliases(),dupes=duplicateRenderers();return {version:VERSION,canonicalCount:defs.length,aliasCount:Object.keys(ALIASES).length,byType,domains,aliasCycles:cycles,brokenReferences:broken,unresolvedAliases:badAliases,duplicateRendererOwners:dupes,pass:!cycles.length&&!broken.length&&!badAliases.length}}

const API={version:VERSION,definitions:Object.freeze({...DEFINITIONS}),aliases:Object.freeze({...ALIASES}),collections:Object.freeze({...COLLECTION}),get:id=>{const r=resolve(id);return r.ok?{...r.definition}:null},resolve,open,list:(filter={})=>Object.values(DEFINITIONS).filter(d=>(!filter.type||d.type===filter.type)&&(!filter.domain||d.domain===filter.domain)).map(d=>({...d})),canonicalForElement,auditDOM,qa};
globalThis.AO_MODULES=API;
globalThis.AO_MODULE_REGISTRY_V36=API;
})();

</script>

window.AO_V360_META={version:'36.0',baseline:'Ad-Orientem-2.0-v35.7-DAILY-CATECHISM.html',scope:['canonical module registry','legacy alias resolution','route adapters','module ownership diagnostics'],visibleNavigationChanged:false,contentChanged:false,progressStorageChanged:false,massEngineChanged:false,calendarEngineChanged:false,prayerCorpusChanged:false,newMutationObserverAdded:false};

<script id="ao-v361-launcher-migration">

(()=>{'use strict';
const VERSION='36.1-launcher-migration';
const MOD=globalThis.AO_MODULES;
if(!MOD?.open||!MOD?.resolve)return;

let canonicalRoutingDepth=0;
const baseOpen=MOD.open.bind(MOD);

async function canonicalOpen(input,options={}){
  canonicalRoutingDepth++;
  try{return await baseOpen(input,options)}
  finally{canonicalRoutingDepth=Math.max(0,canonicalRoutingDepth-1)}
}
MOD.open=canonicalOpen;

const CAPABILITY_SELECTOR=[
  '[data-action]',
  '[data-pb-module]',
  '[data-pb-existing]',
  '[data-v26-module]',
  '[data-v26-open]',
  '[data-v261-adapter]',
  '[data-v261-legacy-module]',
  '[data-v352-adapter]',
  '[data-v352-manage-intentions]',
  '[data-ao354-open]',
  '[data-ao354-launch]',
  '[data-ao354-module]',
  '[data-ao354-trad]',
  '[data-v25-destination]',
  '[data-dc-open]',
  '[data-open-catechism]',
  '.aoLearnLaunch',
  '.aoCateLaunch'
].join(',');

const ADAPTER_MAP={
  prepare:'mass.prepare',
  prepare_communion:'mass.communion_prepare',
  thanks:'mass.thanksgiving',
  confession:'pray.confession'
};
const ACTION_MAP={
  prepare:'prepare',
  follow:'follow',
  thanks:'thanks',
  'today-mass':'today-mass',
  gospel:'gospel'
};
const PB_MODULE_MAP={
  confession:'confession',
  rosary:'rosary',
  angelus:'angelus',
  stations:'stations',
  benediction:'benediction'
};
const PB_EXISTING_MAP={prepare:'prepare',thanks:'thanks'};
const EUCHARISTIC_MAP={
  adoration:'adoration',
  'first-friday':'first-friday',
  'first-saturday':'first-saturday',
  meditation:'first-saturday-meditation'
};
const DESTINATION_MAP={
  prayers:'prayers',
  calendar:'calendar',
  saint:'saint',
  settings:'settings',
  sources:'sources',
  'today-mass':'today-mass'
};

function routeDescriptor(el){
  if(!el)return null;
  const d=el.dataset||{};

  if(d.action&&ACTION_MAP[d.action]) return {input:ACTION_MAP[d.action],origin:'data-action'};
  if(d.pbModule&&PB_MODULE_MAP[d.pbModule]) return {input:PB_MODULE_MAP[d.pbModule],origin:'data-pb-module'};
  if(d.pbExisting&&PB_EXISTING_MAP[d.pbExisting]) return {input:PB_EXISTING_MAP[d.pbExisting],origin:'data-pb-existing'};

  if(d.v26Module) return {input:d.v26Module,origin:'data-v26-module'};
  if(d.v26Open) return {input:d.v26Open,origin:'data-v26-open'};
  if(d.v261LegacyModule) return {input:d.v261LegacyModule,origin:'data-v261-legacy-module'};
  if(d.v261Adapter&&ADAPTER_MAP[d.v261Adapter]) return {input:ADAPTER_MAP[d.v261Adapter],origin:'data-v261-adapter'};
  if(d.v352Adapter&&ADAPTER_MAP[d.v352Adapter]) return {input:ADAPTER_MAP[d.v352Adapter],origin:'data-v352-adapter'};
  if(d.v352ManageIntentions!==undefined) return {input:'mass.intentions',origin:'data-v352-manage-intentions'};

  if(d.ao354Open&&EUCHARISTIC_MAP[d.ao354Open]) return {input:EUCHARISTIC_MAP[d.ao354Open],origin:'data-ao354-open'};
  if(d.ao354Launch&&EUCHARISTIC_MAP[d.ao354Launch]) return {input:EUCHARISTIC_MAP[d.ao354Launch],origin:'data-ao354-launch'};
  if(d.ao354Module&&PB_MODULE_MAP[d.ao354Module]) return {input:PB_MODULE_MAP[d.ao354Module],origin:'data-ao354-module'};
  if(d.ao354Trad) return {input:d.ao354Trad,origin:'data-ao354-trad'};

  if(d.v25Destination&&DESTINATION_MAP[d.v25Destination]) return {input:DESTINATION_MAP[d.v25Destination],origin:'data-v25-destination'};
  if(d.dcOpen!==undefined) return {input:'daily-catechism',origin:'data-dc-open'};
  if(d.openCatechism!==undefined) return {input:'catechism',origin:'data-open-catechism'};
  if(el.classList?.contains('aoLearnLaunch')) return {input:'learn',origin:'aoLearnLaunch'};
  if(el.classList?.contains('aoCateLaunch')) return {input:'catechism',origin:'aoCateLaunch'};
  return null;
}

function explainElement(el){
  const descriptor=routeDescriptor(el);
  if(!descriptor)return {mapped:false,reason:'LOCAL_OR_NONCANONICAL_CONTROL'};
  const resolved=MOD.resolve(descriptor.input);
  return {
    mapped:!!resolved.ok,
    input:descriptor.input,
    origin:descriptor.origin,
    canonicalId:resolved.ok?resolved.id:null,
    defaults:resolved.ok?resolved.defaults||{}:{},
    error:resolved.ok?null:resolved.error
  };
}

async function migrateClick(event){
  if(canonicalRoutingDepth>0)return;
  const raw=event.target;
  if(!(raw instanceof Element))return;
  const el=raw.closest(CAPABILITY_SELECTOR);
  if(!el)return;
  // v43.20: these controls have newer, surface-specific owners. Do not let the
  // legacy Window-capture migration swallow their authoritative handlers.
  if(el.matches('[data-open-catechism]')&&el.closest('#ao-learn-root'))return;
  if(el.matches('[data-action="follow"]')&&el.closest('.phaseActions'))return;
  if(el.matches('[data-action="today-mass"]')&&el.closest('.massCard'))return;
  const info=explainElement(el);
  if(!info.mapped)return;

  event.preventDefault();
  event.stopPropagation();
  event.stopImmediatePropagation();

  el.dataset.aoCanonicalModule=info.canonicalId;
  el.dataset.aoCanonicalOrigin=info.origin;

  const result=await canonicalOpen(info.input,{launcherOrigin:info.origin});
  try{
    globalThis.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ao:canonical-route',{
      detail:{...info,result}
    }));
  }catch{}
}

function auditDOM(root=document){
  const nodes=[...root.querySelectorAll(CAPABILITY_SELECTOR)];
  const mapped=[],local=[],broken=[];
  for(const el of nodes){
    const info=explainElement(el);
    const row={
      tag:el.tagName?.toLowerCase()||'',
      text:(el.textContent||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,100),
      ...info
    };
    if(info.mapped)mapped.push(row);
    else if(info.error)broken.push(row);
    else local.push(row);
  }
  return {
    version:VERSION,
    launcherCount:nodes.length,
    mappedCount:mapped.length,
    localControlCount:local.length,
    brokenCount:broken.length,
    mapped,local,broken
  };
}

function qa(){
  const base=MOD.qa?.()||{};
  const required=[
    'prepare','MASS_PREP_BALT_1888','COMM_PREP_LAS_1911','MASS_FOUR_ENDS_LAS_1911',
    'COMM_THANKS_LAS_1911','CONFESSION_LAS_1911','rosary','confession','benediction',
    'adoration','first-friday','first-saturday','daily-catechism','calendar','gospel',
    'settings','sources'
  ];
  const routeChecks=required.map(input=>{
    const r=MOD.resolve(input);
    return {input,ok:!!r.ok,canonicalId:r.ok?r.id:null,error:r.ok?null:r.error};
  });
  return {
    version:VERSION,
    registryPass:!!base.pass,
    routeChecks,
    routeChecksPass:routeChecks.every(x=>x.ok),
    captureLayer:'window',
    newMutationObserverAdded:false,
    visibleNavigationChanged:false,
    localControlsDeliberatelyExcluded:[
      'Home More disclosure',
      'Prayer Book category/search controls',
      'Traditional Exercises legacy hub controls',
      'Eucharistic programmes internal back/programmes navigation',
      'individual prayer-record links'
    ],
    pass:!!base.pass&&routeChecks.every(x=>x.ok)
  };
}

globalThis.addEventListener('click',migrateClick,true);

MOD.routeForElement=routeDescriptor;
MOD.explainElement=explainElement;
MOD.auditLaunchers=auditDOM;
MOD.qaLaunchers=qa;

globalThis.AO_LAUNCHER_MIGRATION_V361={
  version:VERSION,
  selector:CAPABILITY_SELECTOR,
  explainElement,
  auditDOM,
  qa
};
})();

</script>

<!-- AO v43.33: canonical icon ownership registry. Renderers consume this directly; no timer/retry decorators. -->
<style id="ao-v4333-native-icon-ownership-css">
.aoV4333NativeIcon{width:38px;height:38px;display:block;flex:0 0 auto;overflow:visible;color:var(--liturgical,var(--gold,currentColor));margin:0 0 9px}
.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:10px;align-items:start}
.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized>.aoV4333NativeIcon{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/5;margin:1px 0 0}
.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized>.type,.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized>strong,.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized>p{grid-column:2}
.aoGlobalRibbonIcon .aoRibbonSprite{width:31px;height:31px;display:block;overflow:visible}
#ao-global-ribbon{z-index:15680!important}
@media(max-width:430px){.aoV4333NativeIcon{width:34px;height:34px}.aoV37CardMain.aoV4333NativeIconized{grid-template-columns:38px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:8px}}
</style>
<script id="ao-v4333-icon-registry-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
 const ROUTE_MAP=Object.freeze({"pray.adoration":"ao-rich-adoration","pray.rosary":"ao-rich-rosary","pray.angelus_regina":"ao-rich-angelus","programme.first_saturday":"ao-rich-immaculate-heart","programme.first_friday":"ao-rich-sacred-heart","pray.stations":"ao-rich-stations","pray.confession":"ao-rich-confession","pray.library":"ao-rich-prayer-library","mass.prepare":"ao-rich-mass-preparation-thanksgiving","mass.communion_prepare":"ao-rich-eucharistic-life","mass.thanksgiving":"ao-rich-mass-preparation-thanksgiving","learn.mass":"ao-rich-guides"});
 const PB_MAP=Object.freeze({"confession":"ao-rich-confession","rosary":"ao-rich-rosary","angelus":"ao-rich-angelus","stations":"ao-rich-stations"});
 const RIBBON_MAP=Object.freeze({"home":"ao-rich-recollection","pray":"ao-rich-prayer-library","learn":"ao-refined-study","calendar":"ao-refined-calendar-upcoming"});
 const COMING_MAP=Object.freeze({"calendar":"ao-refined-calendar-upcoming","rosary":"ao-rich-rosary","mass":"ao-rich-mass-preparation-thanksgiving","angelus":"ao-rich-angelus","exam":"ao-rich-examination-of-conscience","heart":"ao-rich-sacred-heart","marian":"ao-rich-our-lady-marian-devotions","church":"ao-refined-church","prayer":"ao-refined-pray-now","morning":"ao-rich-morning-offering","evening":"ao-rich-night-prayer","stations":"ao-rich-stations"});
 function symbolExists(id){return !!id&&!!document.getElementById(id)}
 function markup(id,cls='aoV4333NativeIcon'){return id?`<svg class="${cls}" viewBox="0 0 128 128" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#${id}"></use></svg>`:''}
 function iconForRoute(route,cls='aoV4333NativeIcon'){const id=ROUTE_MAP[route];return id?markup(id,cls):''}
 function svgNode(id,cls='aoV4333NativeIcon'){if(!id)return null;const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('class',cls);svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 128 128');svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.setAttribute('focusable','false');const use=document.createElementNS(NS,'use');use.setAttribute('href','#'+id);svg.appendChild(use);return svg}
 globalThis.AO_ICON_REGISTRY_V4333=Object.freeze({version:'43.33',routeMap:ROUTE_MAP,pbMap:PB_MAP,ribbonMap:RIBBON_MAP,comingMap:COMING_MAP,markup,iconForRoute,svgNode,symbolExists});
})();
</script>
<script id="ao-v37-content-delivery-js">
(()=>{'use strict';
const VERSION='v37-content-delivery';
const CACHE_PREFIX='ao2:content-v37:';
const DAILY_TTL=48*60*60*1000;
const MEMORY=new Map();
const STATUS=new Map();
const DAILY_DOCS=new Map();
let currentDaily=null,lastDailyKey='',prefetchedTomorrow=null,storeUnsub=null,booted=false,diagOpen=false;
const esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[c]));
const now=()=>Date.now();
const state=()=>globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8?.store?.getState?.()||null;
const lang=()=>state()?.language==='fr'?'fr':'en';
const L=(en,fr)=>lang()==='fr'?fr:en;
const MANIFEST=Object.freeze({
 proper:Object.freeze({id:'proper',delivery:'daily-resolved',cache:'resolver/runtime',trigger:'day resolution',required:true,fallback:'explicit unavailable state'}),
 scripture:Object.freeze({id:'scripture',delivery:'daily-prefetch',cache:'session memory',trigger:'Proper ready',scope:'Gospel + Epistle/Lesson',required:false,fallback:'load on reader open'}),
 commentary:Object.freeze({id:'commentary',delivery:'daily-prefetch',cache:'session memory + provider caches',trigger:'Proper ready',scope:'Gospel + Epistle/Lesson',required:false,fallback:'explicit unavailable / source link'}),
 saintIdentity:Object.freeze({id:'saintIdentity',delivery:'daily-derived',cache:'daily summary',trigger:'day resolution',required:false,fallback:'liturgical title'}),
 saintBiography:Object.freeze({id:'saintBiography',delivery:'module-lazy',cache:'Saint reader memory',trigger:'Saint of the Day open',required:false,fallback:'explicit no sourced biography'}),
 saintArtwork:Object.freeze({id:'saintArtwork',delivery:'module-lazy',cache:'saint-art cache',trigger:'Home card / Saint of the Day open',required:false,fallback:'approved-art placeholder'}),
 catechism:Object.freeze({id:'catechism',delivery:'module-lazy',cache:'persistent module cache',trigger:'Catechism open',expected:433,required:false,fallback:'verified embedded English core'}),
 traditionalExercises:Object.freeze({id:'traditionalExercises',delivery:'module package',cache:'embedded verified package / future external package',trigger:'Traditional Exercise open',required:false,fallback:'source-verified embedded package'}),
 eucharisticProgrammes:Object.freeze({id:'eucharisticProgrammes',delivery:'embedded controller + lazy linked prayers',cache:'module state',trigger:'Programme open',required:false})
});
function setStatus(id,status,detail={}){const x={id,status,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),...detail};STATUS.set(id,x);if(diagOpen)renderDiagnostics();return x}
function getStatus(id){return STATUS.get(id)||{id,status:'idle'}}
function safeGet(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(CACHE_PREFIX+k)}catch{return MEMORY.get(k)||null}}
function safeSet(k,v){const text=JSON.stringify(v);MEMORY.set(k,text);try{localStorage.setItem(CACHE_PREFIX+k,text)}catch{}return v}
function safeDel(k){MEMORY.delete(k);try{localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_PREFIX+k)}catch{}}
function readCache(k){const raw=safeGet(k);if(!raw)return null;try{const x=JSON.parse(raw);if(x.expiresAt&&x.expiresAt<now()){safeDel(k);return null}return x}catch{return null}}
function pruneDaily(){try{const keys=[];for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){const k=localStorage.key(i);if(k?.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX+'daily:'))keys.push(k)}keys.sort((a,b)=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(b)).savedAt-JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(a)).savedAt}catch{return 0}});keys.slice(14).forEach(k=>localStorage.removeItem(k))}catch{}}
function normalizeCommentary(doc){const docs=doc?.parts?.length?doc.parts:[doc];const valid=docs.filter(Boolean);if(!valid.length)return{status:'unavailable',references:[]};const references=valid.map(x=>x.reference?.display||x.reference?.displayFr||'').filter(Boolean);const en=valid.every(x=>x.reference?.kind==='gospel'?!!x.englishCatena?.length:(!!x.englishCommentary?.entries?.length||!!x.englishNotes?.length));const fr=valid.every(x=>!!x.frenchCommentary?.entries?.length||!!x.frenchCatena?.length);return{status:(en||fr)?'ready':'partial',references,en,fr,parts:valid.length}}
function dailyKey(s){const p=s?.resolution?.proper?.status==='ready'?s.resolution.proper.data:null;return `${s?.selectedDate||''}|${s?.language||''}|${p?.sourcePath||p?.properId||''}`}
function deriveDaily(s){const r=s?.resolution,p=r?.proper?.status==='ready'?r.proper.data:null,day=r?.day||null;return{
 version:VERSION,date:s?.selectedDate||null,language:s?.language||'en',generatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),
 celebration:{title:p?.name||p?.title?.en||day?.main?.title||null,titleFr:p?.nameFr||p?.title?.fr||null,rank:p?.rank||day?.main?.rank||null,colour:r?.colourPlan?.label||day?.main?.color||null,sourcePath:p?.sourcePath||p?.path||day?.main?.path||null},
 proper:{status:r?.proper?.status||'idle',languageCoverage:p?.languageCoverage||null,sourcePath:p?.sourcePath||null},
 scripture:{gospel:p?.gospel?{status:'queued'}:{status:'unavailable'},epistle:p?.epistle?{status:'queued'}:{status:'unavailable'}},
 commentary:{gospel:p?.gospel?{status:'queued'}:{status:'unavailable'},epistle:p?.epistle?{status:'queued'}:{status:'unavailable'}},
 saint:{status:day?.main?'ready':'unavailable',title:day?.main?.title||null,commemorations:(day?.commemorations||[]).map(x=>x.title||x.name).filter(Boolean),biography:'lazy',artwork:'lazy'},
 cache:{dailySummary:'pending',tomorrow:'idle'}
}}
async function prefetchReading(slot,kind,text,key){const rt=globalThis.AO_RUNTIME_V8;if(!rt?.scriptureService||!text)return null;setStatus('daily:'+slot,'loading',{key});try{const doc=await rt.scriptureService.load(kind,text);DAILY_DOCS.set(key+':'+slot,doc);const info=normalizeCommentary(doc);setStatus('daily:'+slot,'ready',{key,reference:info.references.join(' · '),commentary:info});return{doc,info}}catch(e){setStatus('daily:'+slot,'error',{key,error:String(e?.message||e)});return null}}
async function hydrateDaily(s=state(),{force=false}={}){if(!s?.resolution)return null;const key=dailyKey(s);if(!force&&key===lastDailyKey&&currentDaily)return currentDaily;lastDailyKey=key;currentDaily=deriveDaily(s);setStatus('proper',currentDaily.proper.status==='ready'?'ready':currentDaily.proper.status,{sourcePath:currentDaily.proper.sourcePath,languageCoverage:currentDaily.proper.languageCoverage});setStatus('saintIdentity',currentDaily.saint.status,{title:currentDaily.saint.title});
 const p=s.resolution?.proper?.status==='ready'?s.resolution.proper.data:null;if(!p){cacheDaily(currentDaily);return currentDaily}
 setStatus('scripture','loading',{scope:'Gospel + Epistle/Lesson'});setStatus('commentary','loading',{scope:'Gospel + Epistle/Lesson'});
